note: Calendar head + provisioning: POST /calendar/provision creates an account (argon2id), a calendar whose policy asks the `_calendar` stack before a client edit commits, a daily hello event from event{}, and a feed token. The calendar is then readable by any CalDAV client on the web port under /dav/ (Basic auth over plaintext in dev), the feed at /dav/feed/<token>.ics needs no auth, and the `_calendar` stack refuses non-daily puts and snaps daily ones to the hour. Binds localhost → calendar-demo for the route and pony.local.thanks.computer (dev-local, auto-verified) as the domain the username must belong to. Needs `txco dev --calendar`.
